scope: CPU level-zero linear-light bilinear sampling at geometry triangle centroids, weighted by rest surface area. Seam-split UVs and full triangle IDs retained. Bands approximate front knee and mid-shin surfaces from native rest bone landmarks; they are not painted anatomical masks.
limits: No rendered colour, light, normal, texture mip, postprocess, animation or perception measurement.
Centroid quadrature is an approximation, not an integral over all atlas pixels.
No asset or material edit, native A/B or performance qualification.
Jaw is deliberately omitted: no validated lower-face boundary is defined by this leg protocol.
